name: Chat turn over a knowledge group
objective: One answer to a conversation so far, written from what a knowledge group holds on the latest message. Pictures attached to the message are read first by the eyes role (a model that can see), and what it read joins the message as text.

library.about: the knowledge group whose passages the answer is written from. Several may be used together. Optional: left empty, the answer is written without any.

eyes.about: reads pictures attached to a message (text verbatim, a translation, what is shown) so the model that answers gets them as text. Any model that can see; it may be the same as the one that answers.

prompt.label: Prompt
prompt.hint: A prompt kept in the library, put before the standing instructions.

contexts.label: Contexts
contexts.hint: Contexts kept in the library, added after the prompt.

options.label: The knowledge group's own options
options.hint: What the program behind the group takes for a question. Left empty, an option is not sent and the program's own default holds.

session.label: Cache session
session.hint: Names the model's kept state for this piece of work, so a machine that keeps such state (the llama program's KV ring) continues from it instead of reading everything again. A conversation gives its own id.

pictures.label: Pictures with the last message
pictures.hint: Images (base64, as Ollama's messages carry them) attached to the message being answered. Each is read by the eyes role first; the model that answers gets what was read as text, so it needs no vision of its own.

look.label: How a picture is read
look.default: Read this picture exactly. First write out all text in it, verbatim and in its original language, keeping its layout as text (lists, tables, arrows, what is grouped together). If any of the text is not in the language named at the end, then give a translation of it into that language. Then say briefly what is drawn or shown that the text does not say. Do not guess at text you cannot read; mark it [unreadable].

language.label: Language to translate pictures' text into

eyes.about: reads attached pictures for the model that answers
